description:
The game must remain finishable without Suicune, with harm the player cannot repair.

Proposed aftermath, as an alternative to the hopeful crossing: survivors make a longer land detour because the familiar water route remains unsafe. The winter community can still repair a shared room and receive supplies. This preserves a real victory and continuing care while a visible wound endures; it does not decree the fate of every town or character. Choose the remaining harm together with the final supernatural mechanism, not as an extra punishment for missing a collectible.

data.description: This is a viable victory without the unique solution, not an instruction to kill Suicune or an automatic result of every unfinished healing attempt.
Proposed aftermath visits show community work continuing without resolving Koga’s disappearance.
